backend_standards.error_handling: Always check errors; no panic() in production code.
backend_standards.logging: JSON structured logs for ingestion into monitoring.

frontend_standards.styling: Prefer Vanilla CSS or Tailwind (if already used).
frontend_standards.components: Functional components with Hooks. Strict typing for Props.

governance_standards.quarantine: All AI patches must go to 'quarantine/' branch prefix.
governance_standards.audit: Every tool call must have a rationale and timestamp.
governance_standards.rag: Agents must query the RAG before starting complex tasks.
